hypotheses.summary: The fictional records define three controls but omit a shared demand-shift comparison.

gaps.description: The synthetic records do not compare queue delay and capacity use under the same demand transition.
gaps.supporting_evidence: Each fictional claim defines one control, but none reports a joint three-regime run.
gaps.significance: The comparison would demonstrate the hypothesis import and human-review workflow.
gaps.suggested_approach: Run all three fictional controls on one fixed low-high-recovery demand trace and compare delay and capacity use.
